ONE hornless shaggy-haired monstrous head with exaggerated broad contorted ogre jaw and prominent sharp teeth/fangs, deeply wrinkled face; no ordinary monk's face. TWO long arms end in extremely LONG BENT BONY CLAW FINGERS with hooked pointed nails, stretched distinctly in front along roof; TWO legs behind under a modest opaque tattered brown monk robe, both clawed feet separately visible. Body coherent with only two arms/two legs, crouched crawling posture as Sekien. Full head, entire robe/body, both clawed hands and both feet entirely within frame with ample margin. Three-quarter front-side view emphasizes actual structural grotesque claw hands and face. Menacing furtive nocturnal temple-stalker aura, not benevolent wise priest. Traditional Japanese tiled eave, wooden temple railing and distant bell tower, moonlit deep forest green and weathered walnut wood, soft antique gold ambient temple light, refined naturalistic oil-painted detail. No horns, wings, extra arms, extra legs, weapons, victims, blood, text, inscriptions, signatures, border or watermark. Source-attested demon anatomy should be apparent without adding generic demon motifs. One individual only.
